records.text: Owens described John and Marina Mappin as donors who wrote a letter saying what Turning Point USA was doing was wrong
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And it's kind of beautiful that the person that Charlie (Charlie Kirk) reached out to and said, "Can you put together just any place for Candace (Candace Owens) and I to speak at?" was John and Marina Mappin, the lone donors who wrote that beautiful letter that has impacted the world—like true friends of Charlie (Charlie Kirk) who stood up and said that what Turning Point USA is doing is wrong.

records.text: Owens said Irina Mappin told her in a private phone call that she was disturbed by how many Russian speakers were in the VIP area at the memorial event.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: He's married to Irina and Irina is fluent in speaking Russian. And she remarked to me in a private phone call that the thing that struck her as very odd about the memorial event. ... Was that everyone was speaking Russian?

verification.notes: This is attributed to a private phone call. No recording, contemporaneous message, attendee count, or independently corroborated account establishes what Irina Mappin said or how many VIP attendees spoke Russian.

records.text: Candace Owens said she met George Farmer at a London event hosted by John and Irina Mappin in 2018, where she appeared with Charlie Kirk.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I was with Charlie (Charlie Kirk). The event was hosted by John (John Mappin) and Irina (Irina Mappin) back in 2018. And me and Charlie (Charlie Kirk) were on stage.

records.text: Owens said John and Irina Mappin helped take Turning Point USA to a higher financial level by making introductions for Charlie Kirk.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And it should be known that they were close to Charlie (Charlie Kirk). They helped to bring Charlie (Charlie Kirk) and Turning Point USA to the next level by making introductions for Charlie (Charlie Kirk) that I would say launch the organization into a different stratosphere financially.

records.text: Owens said Charlie Kirk, Erika Kirk, John Mappin, and Irina Mappin traveled to Israel together.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Charlie (Charlie Kirk) and Erika (Erika Kirk) and John (John Mappin) and Irina (Irina Mappin) went to Israel. They were invited by them to go. They also know Michael McCoy very well. They adore Mikey (Michael McCoy).

records.text: John and Irina Mappin wrote that the Charlie Kirk crime scene had apparently been destroyed within days and that substantial evidence did not appear to add up.
records.speaker: John Mappin

appearances.snippet: What we have seen so far beggars belief. A crime scene apparently completely destroyed in days and plenty of evidence that simply does not seem to add up.

conveyance.original_source: Candace Owens, Charlie Kirk and the Pursuit of Truth

records.text: John and Irina Mappin wrote that executing a possibly innocent person despite remaining doubt would violate Christian teachings and have far-reaching international consequences.
records.speaker: John Mappin

appearances.snippet: The truth, when known, and we believe it will be known, will have far-reaching international consequences. The very idea that someone could be convicted and could receive the death penalty when there remains even the slightest shadow of a doubt or a shred of uncertainty that they may not be guilty of that crime and that Christian souls would tolerate that possibility is anathema to all the teachings of Christ.
